name: @flagqai/cli
description: FlagQAI terminal client for agentic scientific and software workflows.

scripts.build:dsh-std: pnpm --dir vendor/dsh-std install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm --dir vendor/dsh-std --filter @dsh-std/core --filter @dsh-std/manifest --filter @dsh-std/connection --filter @dsh-std/presentation --filter @dsh-std/command --filter @dsh-std/storage --filter @dsh-std/messages -r build
scripts.compile: node scripts/build-vendor.mjs && npm run clean && node scripts/sync-local-server.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/gen-settings-json.mjs
scripts.compile:src: node scripts/verify-ui-core-source.mjs && node scripts/sync-local-server.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/gen-settings-json.mjs
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run verify:build
scripts.verify:distribution: node scripts/verify-flagqai-identity.mjs && node --import tsx/esm scripts/verify-chat-terminal-title.mjs && node scripts/verify-standalone-cache-guard.mjs
scripts.verify:approval-visibility: node --import tsx/esm scripts/verify-approval-visibility.tsx && npm run verify:approval-source-badge
scripts.verify:workspace-paths: node --import tsx/esm scripts/verify-workspace-paths.ts && node scripts/verify-session-cwd.mjs && node scripts/verify-file-completion.mjs
scripts.verify:flagquantum-policy: node scripts/verify-flagquantum-policy.mjs && node --import tsx/esm scripts/verify-quantum-input-guard.ts && node --test scripts/quantum-preflight.test.mjs scripts/quantum-preflight-fixture.test.mjs scripts/quantum-route.test.mjs
scripts.verify:remote-attach: node scripts/verify-remote-attach.mjs && node scripts/verify-attach-native-controls.mjs && node scripts/verify-attach-image-drafts.mjs
